sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-3b"
sources.quote: WASP-3b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star WASP-3 located approximately 800 light-years away in the constellation Lyra.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-3. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-3b"
sources.quote: It was discovered via the transit method by SuperWASP, and follow up radial velocity observations confirmed that WASP-3b is a planet.
